response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_rate AS rate_difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY rate_difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average rate gives each AlbumId group equal weight, including the group with a NULL AlbumId. AVG ignores groups whose rate is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: “Across all albums” excludes the no-album group from the benchmark, though that group can still appear in the results.
alternatives.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate FROM album_rates WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_rate AS rate_difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY rate_difference DESC LIMIT 10
